_comment: Normative constants for the RoboTensor one-demonstration in-context imitation learning competition. The validator and the dashboard both read this file; nothing in it may be duplicated as a literal in code. spec_fingerprint = sha256 of the canonical JSON of this file. Changing spec_version changes every derived duel_id and therefore every draw; bump it only deliberately.

track.title: One-demo in-context imitation
track._comment: The model is shown exactly one demonstration of the task and no language. The demonstration is the whole prompt.

spatial.title: Spatial change
spatial.blurb: Same task as the demonstration, but the objects and the robot start somewhere else. Positions come from LIBERO-PRO's swap and pose perturbations plus an explicit displacement ladder.

environment.title: Environment change
environment.blurb: Same task and layout, but the scene sits on a different table in a different room, and the lights are randomized.

object.title: Object change
object.blurb: Same kind of task, but the target object is swapped for another object that affords the same operation. The demonstration shows the new pairing; the pairing was never published as training data.

composition.title: Composition
composition.blurb: Two single-step tasks done one after the other. The demonstration is one continuous recording of both steps; success means both goals hold at the end.

pools._comment: pool_id is filled by `icilval pools build` and must equal pool.json's id; the validator refuses to run on a mismatch.

duel._crown_comment: Both sides run the identical unit list (same tasks, initial states, prompt demonstrations and seeds). Per-axis success rate is stored as a fraction in [0, 1]; the final score is the mean of the four axes. The challenger takes the crown iff challenger.average >= king.average + score_margin / 100. Paired per-unit outcomes are published as a diagnostic and never decide the crown.
duel._max_steps_comment: axes.<axis>.max_steps are per-axis caps; each task carries its own (smaller) limit from its source benchmark.

model._comment: A submission is a Hugging Face model repo holding model.safetensors and config.yaml. The validator instantiates the architecture from its own allow-listed template (arch/bpp_libero_v1.cfg.json), diffs the submitted config against it, checks the safetensors header against arch/bpp_libero_v1.tensors.json, and loads weights strictly. No pickle is ever read and no entrant code runs.
model._mutable_comment: Dotted paths under `model` that may differ from the template without affecting inference. Training-only keys are overwritten by the converter, so they never differ.

baseline.label: BPP public checkpoint (austinpatel/libero, converted)
baseline._comment: The genesis king. revision is pinned when the converted checkpoint is published.

store._layout_comment: manifest.json; tracks/{track}/{head.json,queue.json,index-NNNN.jsonl}; events/{track}/{event_id}.json; media/{sha[:2]}/{sha}.mp4. Index lines are '<canonical_json>\t<ed25519_signature_hex>', append-only.
